title: Tool Catalog Ingest — 38-vendor PDF→structured-JSON + STEP files + AI-training + collision-envelope wiring
brief: Ingest the 38 owned vendor tool catalogs (~36K tools, ~36K gap to 90K target) into ToolRegistry with full cutting parameters, usage scenarios, and 2D/3D dimensional envelopes. Download STEP files from PTS Tools, Misumi, Sandvik CoroPlus, Kennametal NOVO, Iscar etool, GrabCAD, TraceParts. Wire the new corpus into CADCorpusIngesterEngine for CAD/CAM AI training and CollisionDetectionEngine for parametric envelope checks. Builds on existing infrastructure (StepImportEngine occt-import-js WASM, CatalogExtractionEngine.CuttingDataSet, CADCorpusIngesterEngine, CAMLoRAAdapterTrainerEngine, CollisionDetectionEngine, ToolHolderDatabaseEngine) — pure orchestration + data, no new physics engines.

decisions.step_storage: store ALL STEP files locally for CAD/CAM AI training (user-approved 4TB SSD, ~20-50GB budget)
decisions.table_extraction_backend: camelot-py via execFileAsync(PYTHON_PATH, ...) — mirrors documentLearningDispatcher pattern
decisions.vendor_classification_authority: 1) pdftotext cover-page verbatim verification (highest), 2) Apr 16 vendor-catalog-manifest, 3) filename heuristic (lowest)

units.title: CatalogExtractionResult schema — TypeScript interface matching manifest.targetJson contract
units.description: Create mcp-server/src/schemas/CatalogExtractionResult.ts. Reuses CatalogExtractionEngine.CuttingDataSet shape (isoGroup, Vc/fz/ap/ae min/max/recommended, conditions, coolant, source). Adds: step_file_path?, datasheet_pdf_path?, application_scenarios[], collision_envelope: {boundingCylinderD, boundingCylinderL, neckD?, neckL?, shankD, gaugeLength?}. Strict zod-style typing.
exit_conditions: Interface fields documented inline with units (mm, °, °C, SFM)
units.verifies_via: node -e "const t=require('typescript'); /* schema compiles */" (typecheck is the gate)

units.title: Extend CuttingTool — 3 optional fields for catalog ingest
units.description: Add step_file_path?, datasheet_pdf_path?, collision_envelope? to CuttingTool in mcp-server/src/registries/ToolRegistry.ts. ALL OPTIONAL — every existing tool record must still load. CollisionEnvelope imported from U-TCI-A1.
exit_conditions: Three optional fields added to CuttingTool interface
All existing CuttingTool consumers compile unchanged
units.verifies_via: npx tsc --noEmit + grep for any existing test that builds a CuttingTool — should still pass

units.title: Catalog storage paths helper — single source of truth
units.description: Create scripts/lib/catalog-storage-paths.mjs. Pure functions: stepPathFor(vendor, partNumber), extractedJsonPathFor(vendor, type), pdfPathFor(filename), datasheetPdfPathFor(vendor, partNumber). Slugify consistent with iter15 generate-vendor-catalog-features.mjs (lowercase, [^a-z0-9]→-, trim leading/trailing -, slice(0,60)). No I/O — only path string building.
exit_conditions: scripts/lib/__tests__/catalog-storage-paths.test.mjs covers each function with at least 3 cases incl. unicode + special-char vendor names
units.verifies_via: node --test

units.title: extract-vendor-pdf.mjs orchestrator — per-vendor PDF→structured-JSON
units.description: scripts/extract-vendor-pdf.mjs. For one vendor: enumerate matching PDFs from manifest, run camelot table extraction (via execFileAsync(PYTHON_PATH, 'scripts/camelot-extract.py', pdfPath)) for cutting tables, run pdftotext for narrative + cover verification, classify entities via CatalogExtractionEngine, write extracted/<vendor>-<type>-extracted.json matching U-TCI-A1 schema. Idempotent + resumable (hash-skip).
exit_conditions: Orchestrator runs against one sample vendor and writes valid extraction JSON
Resume-mode verified: re-running with unchanged PDF skips work + logs SKIP
Camelot wrapper handles malformed PDFs gracefully (errors → recorded, never crash batch)
units.verifies_via: node scripts/extract-vendor-pdf.mjs --vendor tungaloy --dry-run + diff vs manifest.estimatedTools

units.title: Iscar + Tungaloy GC_* extraction (~36K tools, largest batch)
units.description: Run B1 orchestrator on: Master Catalog 2018 Vol. 1 + Vol. 2 + Turning 2018.1 + Milling 2018.1 + Threading 2018.1 (Iscar — 5 catalogs, ~22.9K tools) + GC_2023-2024_{US,G}_{Tooling,Turning-Grooving,Milling,Drilling} (Tungaloy — 8 catalogs, ~18.7K tools). Spot-check 5 random tools per catalog against source PDF. Merge into ToolRegistry via U-TCI-D1.
exit_conditions: ToolRegistry tool count delta ≥ 30,000 after merge
Spot-check report passes for each catalog (≥4 of 5 tools verbatim-match source)
units.verifies_via: node scripts/extract-vendor-pdf.mjs --vendor iscar --verify; same for tungaloy

units.title: Kennametal + Korloy + Big Daishowa + AMPC extraction (~13K tools)
units.description: Run B1 against: Kennametal (3 catalogs), Korloy (2), Big Daishowa (1), AMPC (1, ~6.6K). Merge into ToolRegistry. Same R12 spot-check rule.
units.verifies_via: node scripts/extract-vendor-pdf.mjs --vendor kennametal --verify; korloy; big_daishowa; ampc

units.title: Mid-tier vendor extraction (Sandvik + MA Ford + Rego-Fix + Emuge + Guhring + Seco + OSG + SGS + YG-1 + Mitsubishi + Flash, ~16K tools)
units.description: Run B1 against 11 mid-tier vendors. Each catalog gets one extraction JSON. Spot-check rule applies.
units.verifies_via: node scripts/extract-vendor-pdf.mjs --vendor sandvik --verify; etc per vendor

units.title: Tail vendor extraction (Global CNC + Rapidkut + Orange Vise + AccuPro + Metalmorphosis + zeni + YU25 + Tooling Systems, ~5K tools)
units.description: Run B1 against 8 tail-tier vendors. Tooling Systems.pdf is the genuine-unknown — flag for operator review if extraction yields no clear vendor signature.
units.verifies_via: node scripts/extract-vendor-pdf.mjs --vendor global_cnc --verify; etc

units.title: Vendor STEP URL inventory — seed for portal phase
units.description: Scan all 38 extracted JSONs (from Phase B) for embedded vendor URLs → write state/shared/specs/VENDOR-STEP-URL-INVENTORY.json. Advisory list for phase D.
exit_conditions: VENDOR-STEP-URL-INVENTORY.json exists with per-vendor part-number → URL list
units.verifies_via: JSON.parse round-trip + manual scan of 5 random URLs (should be valid HTTPS)

units.title: Index existing on-disk STEP files
units.description: Walk H:/prism/resources/CAD FILES/, MACHINE MODELS/, JM DIE/, and any other STEP/STP file in the repo. Write mcp-server/data/state/STEP_FILE_INDEX.json (path, vendor-inferred, part-number-inferred, SHA-256). Cross-reference into ToolRegistry's step_file_path field where part-number matches.
exit_conditions: ToolRegistry step_file_path linkage rate ≥ 5% (any non-zero is a win on first pass)
units.verifies_via: node scripts/index-step-files.mjs --report

units.title: Catalog merge orchestrator → ToolRegistry + dataDispatcher action
units.description: scripts/merge-catalog-extraction-to-registry.mjs. Reads extracted/*.json, dedup against existing ToolRegistry via duplicationGuardEngine, upserts with provenance trail. Wired into a new dataDispatcher action catalog_extraction_merge.
exit_conditions: dataDispatcher action catalog_extraction_merge wired + zod schema
Round-trip test: extract → merge → query via catalog_tool_lookup
units.verifies_via: npx vitest run mcp-server/src/__tests__/CatalogMerge.test.ts

units.title: PTS Tools scraper (publicly accessible spec sheets)
units.description: scripts/scrape-pts-tools.mjs via playwright-mcp. URL pattern: /all-categories/[cat]/[sub]/[product].html. Respects robots.txt; rate-limited (1 req / 3s); resumable per-product checkpoint.
units.verifies_via: node scripts/scrape-pts-tools.mjs --dry-run --sample 10

units.title: Misumi scraper (login-gated STEP via meCAD)
units.description: scripts/scrape-misumi.mjs. Requires operator creds (via capture-claude-credentials skill). Misumi exposes STEP via meCAD configurator — playwright walks Generate STEP → download → store at resources/MANUFACTURER_CATALOGS/step/misumi/<part>.step. Aggressive rate-limit (1 req / 3s). Per-part checkpoint file for resume.
exit_conditions: Auth flow verified with operator-provided creds
STEP files validated via StepImportEngine (parseable + bounding box reasonable)
units.verifies_via: node scripts/scrape-misumi.mjs --dry-run --sample 10 (requires operator creds + manual approval)

units.title: Sandvik CoroPlus Tool Library export
units.description: scripts/scrape-sandvik-coroplus.mjs. Uses Sandvik's public Tool Library export endpoint (coromant.com/coroplus/toollibrary). Documented data export — better than scraping.
exit_conditions: Export endpoint integrated; respects rate limits
Per-tool data merged into ToolRegistry with sandvik vendor flag
units.verifies_via: node scripts/scrape-sandvik-coroplus.mjs --report

units.title: Kennametal NOVO + Iscar etool scrapers
units.description: Two scrapers sharing scripts/lib/vendor-portal-base.mjs. Both expose structured product data + STEP downloads (better signal than catalog PDFs).
units.verifies_via: per scraper --dry-run + sample merge

units.title: GrabCAD + TraceParts STEP backfill
units.description: For tools where step_file_path is null after D2-D5, query GrabCAD + TraceParts community libraries. Last-resort STEP source.
exit_conditions: ToolRegistry step_file_path coverage delta measured + reported
units.verifies_via: node scripts/scrape-grabcad-backfill.mjs --report

units.title: Wire STEP corpus into CADCorpusIngesterEngine
units.description: Add resources/MANUFACTURER_CATALOGS/step/**/*.step to CADCorpusIngesterEngine scan roots. Output appends to CAD_CORPUS_ALLVENDOR.jsonl. Triggers CADTrainingCorpusOrchestratorEngine for next CAD-LoRA training cycle.
exit_conditions: Corpus JSONL grows by ≥ 5K entries after first run
CAD-LoRA training cycle picks up new data on next run
units.verifies_via: node scripts/regenerate-cad-corpus.mjs && jq '.entries | length' on the JSONL diff

units.title: Wire cutting-param priors into UltimateSpeedFeedEngine calibration overlay
units.description: When a tool from the catalog is selected, its per-ISO-group recommended Vc/fz from CuttingDataSet becomes a calibration overlay prior (not a hard override). Orchestrator already supports overlays via sf_autopilot_run.
exit_conditions: End-to-end test: catalog tool → calc → overlay applied → confidence boost
No regression in existing SF tests
units.verifies_via: npx vitest run --testNamePattern 'sf-overlay-catalog'

units.title: Wire collision_envelope into CollisionDetectionEngine
units.description: When a catalog tool is referenced in a job, build the parametric bounding-cylinder + holder envelope automatically from the catalog dims. No collision-physics changes — data-flow wire only.
exit_conditions: Round-trip test: catalog tool → collision check → envelope used
units.verifies_via: npx vitest run --testNamePattern 'collision-envelope-catalog'

units.title: System-viz augmentation + close-out
units.description: Extend scripts/generate-vendor-catalog-features.mjs with live per-vendor stats (tool_count_extracted, step_files_downloaded, ai_training_coverage_pct). Register in regen-viz.mjs FAST[] + merge-augmentations.mjs splice (the U-AUDIT-V5 follow-on deferred from prior session). Add ghost.tool_step_corpus L7 roost.
exit_conditions: Feature pack updated with live stats
units.verifies_via: node scripts/generate-vendor-catalog-features.mjs && node scripts/regen-viz.mjs --augment-only && curl http://localhost:8765/api/graph | jq '.nodes | map(select(.type=="vendor-catalog"))'

psn_synergy.action: Cross-link extracted tool specs to Obsidian memories via /route-to-obsidian
Promote per-vendor extraction summaries to knowledge/wiki/code-tribal/ via tribal-to-wiki promoter
Mine vendor recommended-cutting-data into tribal tips
Catalog cutting params feed UltimateSpeedFeedEngine.calibrationFactors; STEP files feed CAD-LoRA training
Wire extracted GRADE_SPEED_FACTORS + coating multipliers into ExtendedTaylorModel + KienzleForceModel calibration overlays
Live per-vendor stats roost via U-TCI-F1

risks: Misumi/PTS ToS may prohibit bulk scraping — mitigation: per-vendor rate limit + GrabCAD/TraceParts fallback (D6)
Camelot table extraction may misparse complex multi-row cutting tables — mitigation: R12 spot-check 5 random rows per catalog, confidence-tag in source field
21 missing zip-part gaps still operator-blocked — out of scope
occt-import-js WASM memory limits on giant STEP files — mitigation: 50MB hard cap + STEPGeometryParserEngine text-only fallback
Vendor publisher mis-attribution (iter12 lesson) — authoritative order: pdftotext cover-verify > Apr manifest > filename heuristic
out_of_scope: Re-uploading the 21 missing zip parts (operator action)
Adding new physics/cutting models (calibration overlays only)
Storing STEP binary inside ToolRegistry (only path reference)
Unattended portal scraping without operator creds (D-3..D-5 gated)
Changing existing PDF text extraction (pdftotext stays; camelot additive)
